suppliedPromptOrKeyDefects.note: Cot3x decreases from +∞ to −∞ on each of the three branches. The function is also undefined at x=0, although that exclusion is omitted from the printed domain.
Translate arcsinx right by 1/2 and up by π/3. Its endpoints come from arguments −1 and 1.
The principal range of arccos is [0,π], so the negative value −π/4 is impossible.
CotP is negative and π≤P≤2π, so P must lie in quadrant IV: sinP<0 and cosP>0.
